baseline.note: rings = the scanned count; rows are [class, selector, lives, continues, rings, requested state, +$35]

bonus_word.note: D2A6 for every BCD ring count and 21 time samples (time = D2C0:D2BF BCD mmss); the original $AB48 ran each cell

panel_digit_bytes.note: D3F2..D3F4 := $2E + 2 * digit (child panel tile offsets, G1-D out of scope)

caps.lives_rows: [lives before, lives after, sound D3.. DE04 (A9 = life sound)]
caps.rings_rows: [table parity zone, ring count, ring count after]

chain.note: columns [zone, player type, ring count, time, lives after, continues after, rings after, D2A6]; baseline lives $12, continues $34; a class-0 count retries and is re-rolled with D12F & 7 = (ring + time) & 7

evidence: CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT: original $A8FA / $AB48 executed on kosarev/z80 (tools/oracle.py); each result is compared with the pure model

retouch_reroll.note: +$35 = $FF, ring count $16 (class 0 on the odd table): rows indexed by the full D12F byte; the result depends only on D12F & 7

retouch_ring_independence.note: D12F & 7 = 5 -> class 6 for every ring count and both zone parities

side_effects.note: $A9FA stores the matched ring count at $DC00 (initialised to $EE in the fixture); no reader of $DC00 was found by an operand scan (UNRESOLVED, no observable effect)
